messages:
ops-bot: Rolling update: KIX1 (apac-kix1) will run a limited preview for the new Gamma-Q12 Dedicated micro-pools (3x 96GB) starting Mon 2026-10-05 09:00 JST. Pilot notes below. :loud_sound:
laura: (product) Invite-only pilot. Target: customers with mid-to-high memory models that need deterministic tail latency. Small seats.
ken: (infra) HW summary: Gamma-Q12 is a 3-GPU 96GB node with midline interconnect. We've added a light-weight KV-cache alignment and an I/O prefetcher for long-context workloads. Benchmarks show ~8-12% token throughput uplift on 16k+ contexts.
izumi: (ops) Scheduling/policy: pilot pools use hybrid mode. We'll run a 48h reserved-priority window on open and then relax to normal fairshare. Pilot-only tweak: min reservation lowered to 4 days for Gamma pockets in KIX1 to speed validation.
infra: Ops config (short): pool=apac-kix1-gammaq-preview, node=gamma-q12, mode=hybrid, priority_window_secs=172800, reserved_weight=240, shared_weight=75. Alert group capacity.gammaq.spill.
sales: Sales note: Sales will invite strategic accounts and offer a 30-day trial addendum. Capacity requests go through the Capacity Request Form in the runbook.
ops-bot: Billing: reserved pockets billed as committed; shared-burst uses on-demand rates. Pilot docs + runbook: https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/gammaq-kix1-preview (internal). Do not share externally.
laura: CS action: notify invited APAC reserved customers and include guidance on the 4-day reservation option.
ken: infra action: deploy KV-cache alignment to staging tonight; prod push pre-open. Monitor for regressions and tag #eng-runtime.
ops-bot: Oncall: add capacity.gammaq.spill to APAC rotation for the pilot. If spill > 10% sustained for 5m, escalate to oncall. :rotating_light:
